title: ExamConfig
description: The single source of truth for the mock-exam format. Changing this file changes the exam; no code edit is required. Cross-field invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by scripts/validate-exam-config.mjs (gate G-CONFIG) and re-asserted by the Jest content suite.

questionCount.description: Questions in one mock paper. UNVERIFIED for AP: sources report 10-20. See docs/00-phase0-exam-format.md.

passMark.description: Correct answers needed to pass, as an absolute count (not a percentage). UNVERIFIED for AP: sources disagree between 60% and 80% of questionCount.

mode.description: per-question: each question has its own countdown, anchored at attempt_answers.presented_at. whole-paper: one countdown for the paper, anchored at attempts.started_at.

secondsPerQuestion.description: Required when mode is per-question; must be null when mode is whole-paper.

totalSeconds.description: Required when mode is whole-paper; must be null when mode is per-question.

allowBackNavigation.description: When false the session screen disables hardware back, swipe-back and header back. UNVERIFIED for AP.

allowSkip.description: When false, Next stays disabled until an option is selected.

negativeMark.description: Marks deducted per wrong answer. 0 = no negative marking. Timeouts and skips never deduct.

sectionMix.description: Questions drawn per topic. Must sum to questionCount (gate G-MIX). INFERRED, not observed: no source states the real test's topic mix.

formatVerifiedOn.description: ISO date on which this format was confirmed against the real test at an RTO. Ships null. While null the pre-exam screen must say the format is unconfirmed - the app never prints a verification date it does not have.
